name: race_strip_rival_line
description: The resource strip's second line in a race (design 5.7, contract-m6.md §5): 'Rival · Wave 7 · 18 lives · 6:12 +120 s', the rival team's current wave, its lives and its race clock so far with what its lost lives add (SimMatch.race_penalty_t: a minute a life since M8). It hangs under the strip on a slim plate, from the first window on, and follows the rival as it plays: its wave, a life lost, its clock. Once the rival's Holdfast goes under (EV_RACE fell) the line says what wins the race: 'Your rival fell on wave 7. Clear wave 7 to win'. No such line outside a race.

steps.msg: the line shows from the first window

steps.assert: scene.build(Game.kit_tower(0), Vector2i(8, 11)) and scene.build(Game.kit_tower(0), Vector2i(11, 11)) and scene.build(Game.kit_tower(1), Vector2i(6, 11)) and scene.build(Game.kit_tower(2), Vector2i(13, 11))
steps.msg: a few towers of mine between the lower stretches

steps.wait_until: Game.sim.hollows[0].wave == 2 and Game.sim.hollows[0].phase == 1 and Game.sim.hollows[0].cursor >= 14 and Game.sim.creeps_on(0) >= 6

steps.msg: the mirror is on its own waves
its wave, its lives and its race clock so far

steps.assert: Game.sim.race_penalty_t(1) == 7200 and node('Hud').rival_line() == 'Rival · Wave %d · 18 lives · %s +120 s' % [rival_wave, Game.race_clock(Game.sim.tick)]
steps.msg: two lives lost add 120 s (a minute each, M8) to its race clock

steps.assert: fell >= 7 and Game.outcome() == '' and node('Hud').rival_line() == 'Your rival fell on wave %d. Clear wave %d to win' % [fell, fell]
steps.msg: once the rival fell: what wins the race
no rival line outside a race
